source_type: own release (Open-i / NLM, Indiana University Chest X-ray Collection, reports only)
license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (licenseURL in every report XML)
split: whole report set (no official split); ClinicBench uses a 10% test split of 341 reports that is not released
text: yes (report text only; images not downloaded)
request_fields: ClinicBench Table 8 radiology prompt ("Summarize the findings ...") + FINDINGS section; reference = IMPRESSION
notes: ClinicBench (Liu et al., EMNLP 2024; github.com/AI-in-Health/ClinicBench @57138be8a73f09bef8980f849789baf57570c5cf) releases only its six new datasets; existing datasets are not redistributed, so the own release was used. The archive has 3,955 report XMLs (extracted to ecgen-radiology/); 3,419 have both FINDINGS and IMPRESSION and form the candidate items. ClinicBench says it follows previous work (R2Gen-style split) and uses 341 test reports; that split list is distributed with the images (Google Drive) and was not downloaded. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: template: ClinicBench radiology report summarization prompt (paper Table 8, adapted from Tu et al. 2023) filled with the report FINDINGS (whitespace collapsed); reports without FINDINGS and IMPRESSION are not items
